title: ing melody ning bunduk keng sisilim
intro: Makiramdam ka kabang ding libis mag-echo lang papuri kayabe ning metung a pinili nang talasuyu ning Allah. Ing siwala a mipagkalub melody, ing pamanatul a panintunan da reng makipagdebate king silid, at ing metal a melambut king banal a utus manaya lang tuklas. ninu ing pigura ning pamanyamba at makatarungan a pamanungkulan a magsalita kapamilatan da reting tanda?
clues: Bendisyunan naku ning Allah king dakal a bage at masanting a siwala ning papuri.
tiru na ku ning Allah na aintindian ing amanu ning makatarungan a pamanatul kareng mipapate.
Arapan ke ing metung a masikan a higanting sundalus king labanan at king kaburian nang Allah simbut ku la.
dininan da kung kabiasnan, awtoridad ampo metung a kasulatan a mibulalag ibat kang Allah.
Kayabe ku la reng bunduk ampo reng ayup keng pamagpuri kang Allah kayabe ku keng bengi ampo keng aldo.
tiru na ku ning Allah na gawang coat ning mail ibat keng bakal a gewa kung malambut para kaku.

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
